papers.title_en: TopoLIA: Topology-Inspired Latent Interaction Attention for Drug Discovery
papers.authors: Xiang Liu, Yiming Ren, Mustafa Hajij, Pietro Liò, Guo-Wei Wei
papers.evidence: 面向药物发现的拓扑启发潜在交互注意力
papers.tldr: 药物发现中，Transformer 的传统源-目标注意力难以建模复杂相互作用。TopoLIA 提出拓扑启发的潜在交互注意力，通过紧凑潜在交互空间实现源-目标依赖的信息交换，并融合拓扑谱表示捕捉多尺度几何与代数关系。在蛋白-配体结合任务上，它从无标注分子结构预训练，重建掩码多尺度谱 token，在多个打分与对接基准达到 SOTA，且优于标准注意力。该工作将拓扑原则同时引入数据表示与网络架构，为复杂异质交互提供通用框架。
papers.abstract_en: The growing sophistication of drug discovery calls for new advances in artificial intelligence (AI). Transformers have underpinned recent breakthroughs in AI, yet their conventional source-target attention mechanism can become a bottleneck for modeling complex interactions. Here, we introduce TopoLIA, a topology-inspired latent interaction attention mechanism that learns not only how much information should be exchanged between interaction partners, but also how that information should be transformed. Source-target-dependent attention is mediated through a compact latent interaction space, providing a structured representation of complex interactions. We further incorporate topological spectral representations to capture multiscale data geometry and extract algebraic relationships. TopoLIA thus incorporates topological principles into both data representation and neural network architecture. We demonstrate TopoLIA on protein-ligand binding, where persistent spectra encode multiscale topological and geometric patterns in 3D protein-ligand complexes, while latent interaction attention (LIA) enables structured, source-target-dependent information exchange. We pretrain TopoLIA by reconstructing masked multiscale spectral tokens from unlabeled molecular structures, yielding transferable structural representations without task-specific annotations. Across multiple scoring and docking benchmarks, TopoLIA achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently outperforms its standard-attention counterpart. Rank analyses show that compact latent dimensions yield the best performance, supporting compact interaction spaces as an effective inductive bias for biomolecular learning. More broadly, LIA provides a general framework for structured, source-target-dependent information exchange that is applicable to diverse scientific and AI problems involving complex heterogeneous interactions.

papers.title_en: FragFlex: Fragment-Based Flexible Molecular Generation for Exploring Vast Chemical Space
papers.evidence: 片段级柔性长度离散扩散分子生成模型
papers.tldr: 药物发现需探索极其庞大的化学空间，分子图扩散模型虽有前景，但常需预先固定图规模。FragFlex提出片段级灵活长度离散扩散，在去噪中联合学习片段图的大小、片段身份与片段间连接，并用附着位点预测器和价态感知组装器还原为原子级分子。在千万级分子生成实验中，它实现近乎完美的化学有效性与高唯一性。该工作为灵活尺寸分子生成和广阔化学空间探索提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Drug discovery requires efficient exploration of an astronomically large chemical space. Molecular graph diffusion models offer a promising approach to this task, but many require graph size to be fixed before generation. Although atom-level insertion and deletion can enable flexible-size generation, jointly modeling molecular size, atom types, and bonds while maintaining chemical validity remains challenging. We introduce FragFlex, a flexible-length discrete diffusion model that performs node insertion and deletion at the fragment level. During denoising, FragFlex jointly learns the size, fragment identities, and inter-fragment connectivity of the fragment graph. A neural attachment-site predictor and valence-aware assembler then convert the generated fragment graph into an atom-level molecule. In large-scale experiments generating 10 million molecules, FragFlex achieves near-perfect chemical validity while maintaining high uniqueness, demonstrating a strong balance between the two.

papers.title_en: OctMole: Multiscale 3D Molecular Generation with Hierarchical Spatial Flows
papers.authors: Yu-Tong Jin, Yi-Yang Tian, Qiwei Ye, Peng-Shuai Wang
papers.evidence: 多尺度八叉树流框架用于3D分子生成
papers.tldr: 3D分子生成需同时确定原子数量、种类与几何，全局形状粗粒度而化学键要求局部精细，现有原子级扩散/流模型多局限于单一尺度，稠密空间场在高分辨率下代价高。OctMole提出多尺度八叉树流框架：分层占据流由粗到细确定分子支撑，联合原子流为占据叶节点分配原子类型与胞内偏移，并以单元扰动增强鲁棒性。在QM9与GEOM-DRUG上，其化学、分布与几何质量优于Uni-3DAR，效率远高于稠密3D生成。中间占据状态支持形状条件与区域编辑。
papers.abstract_en: Generating accurate 3D molecules requires jointly determining a variable number of atoms, their identities, and geometry across spatial scales: global shape emerges coarsely, whereas chemical bonds demand fine local precision. Existing atom-based diffusion and flow models operate largely at a single scale, while dense spatial fields become costly at high resolution. We introduce OctMole, a multiscale octree flow framework for 3D molecular generation. A hierarchical occupancy flow progressively resolves sparse molecular support from coarse to fine, and a joint atom flow assigns atom types and continuous in-cell offsets to occupied leaves. This decomposition combines efficient global structure with subcell geometric precision, while cell corruption improves robustness to generated support. On QM9 and GEOM-DRUG, OctMole achieves strong chemical, distributional, and geometric quality, with particularly clear gains over Uni-3DAR on GEOM-DRUG and substantial efficiency gains over dense 3D generation. As an additional capability, intermediate occupancy states and selected regions provide spatial conditioning without task-specific retraining, supporting multiscale shape conditioning, regional editing, linker generation, and shape interpolation. Code and pretrained checkpoints are available at https://github.com/octree-nn/octmole and https://huggingface.co/Disembo/octmole, respectively.

papers.title_en: MIRRA: Fast, High-Fidelity Molecular Generation with Chemistry-Informed Discrete Flow Matching
papers.authors: Ge Sun, Juan J. de Pablo
papers.evidence: 离散流匹配生成器，实现快速高保真分子生成
papers.tldr: 分子生成需兼顾化学选择准确与采样高效，但化学砌块虽缩小图规模，却使每个节点面临数万种身份选择。MIRRA以化学知识驱动的离散流匹配，仅在需要时计算身份概率，保留完整身份词表，并用共享特征与身份校正区分分子语境。在ZINC250k上，化学与图分布误差较最强基线降低29–31%和53–60%，生成最高快8.6倍；性质靶向每秒新命中多7.8–20.8倍。聚合物测试集周期有效性达100%，而聚合物VAE仅57.0%。
papers.abstract_en: Fast, high-fidelity molecular generation requires accurate chemical choices and efficient sampling. Chemical building blocks reduce graph size, but make each node a choice among tens of thousands of related identities. We introduce MIRRA (Molecular Identity Representation, Refresh and Assembly), a discrete flow-matching generator that learns from chemical knowledge and evaluates identity probabilities only when needed, while keeping every identity in its vocabulary available. Chemical features share information across related blocks, and learned identity corrections distinguish them in molecular context. By deciding which positions will refresh before computing their probabilities, the sampler avoids unused predictions while preserving each sampling transition. Against the strongest baselines in each task, MIRRA reduces chemical and graph distribution errors on ZINC250k by 29-31% and 53-60%, respectively, with generation up to 8.6 times faster. Property targeting yields an estimated 7.8-20.8 times more distinct novel hits per second. On a held-out polymer test set, MIRRA achieves 100% periodic validity with known chain topology, versus 57.0% for a polymer variational autoencoder. These results demonstrate fast, high-fidelity generation with the full chemical vocabulary available throughout sampling.

papers.title_en: MFG: Multi-turn Feedback Guided Molecular Optimization
papers.authors: Trieu Nguyen, Frazier N. Baker, Ruoxi Gao, Daniel Adu-Ampratwum, Xia Ning
papers.evidence: 强化学习大模型框架用于多目标分子优化
papers.tldr: 多目标分子优化需在保持整体结构相似的同时迭代提升多个性质，但现有基于LLM的方法多聚焦单轮优化，且未显式训练模型利用历史反馈。为此，作者提出多轮反馈引导框架MFG，用强化学习训练LLM逐步优化分子，并设计反馈向量与反馈对齐奖励来促进跨轮改进。在十个多目标任务上，GeLLM3O-MFG取得最高平均相似性约束成功率81.50%，优于基线的70.81%。该工作表明反馈引导的多轮训练能提升LLM分子优化性能。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-objective molecular optimization is a critical process in drug discovery that aims to modify a given molecule to simultaneously improve multiple properties while maintaining a similar overall structure. This process often requires iterative modifications guided by computational or experimental feedback. Recent large language model (LLM)-based methods have begun to explore this iterative approach; however, these methods are not explicitly trained to leverage such feedback, while existing approaches primarily focus on single-turn molecular optimization. To address this gap, we introduce Multi-turn Feedback Guided (MFG) molecular optimization, a reinforcement learning framework that trains an LLM to progressively optimize molecules using feedback from previous turns. MFG introduces a feedback vector capturing both property improvements and source molecule similarity, alongside a feedback-aligned reward function that promotes progressive improvement across turns. We apply MFG over $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O}$, a state-of-the-art LLM model for multi-objective molecular optimization, evaluate $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O-MFG}$ on ten multi-objective molecular optimization tasks. The results demonstrate that $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O-MFG}$ achieves the highest average similarity-constrained success rate ($81.50%$), outperforming the base model $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O}$ ($70.81%$).

papers.title_en: PairIT: Autoregressive Transformers for Low-Data Molecule Optimization
papers.authors: Hannah Lawrence, Bodhi P. Vani, Ji Won Park, Natasa Tagasovska, Samuel Don Stanton, Andrew Martin Watkins, Michael Maser, Ewa M. Nowara
papers.evidence: 自回归Transformer实现种子分子优化，生成有化学意义的编辑
papers.tldr: 分子优化在药物发现中至关重要，但真实任务往往要求以种子分子为起点、同时优化多个性质，并面临数据稀疏难题。PairIT 是一个面向 SMILES 序列的自回归 Transformer 训练框架，它利用结构相似分子对学习局部且化学合理的编辑，并通过 prompt token 指定目标性质、优化方向和变化幅度。多个 prompt 可拼接以支持推理时多性质优化，必要时还可用强化学习后训练调节种子邻近性与优化目标。实验表明，仅 68M 参数的标准模型经配对数据整理后，即可在 MoleculeNet 和 TDC 上实现稳健的低数据种子分子优化，且预训练数据规模收益递减。
papers.abstract_en: Generating novel molecules with desired properties is a central challenge in drug discovery. Although foundational work focused on de novo generation, practical use cases require a more complex setting: conditioning on an initial seed molecule, optimizing multiple properties, and operating in data-sparse regimes. We introduce PairIT, a flexible training framework for autoregressive transformers over SMILES sequences that enables seeded generation by learning from pairs of structurally similar molecules. By leveraging matched pairs, the model learns to generate local, chemically meaningful edits that improve a property of the seed molecule. Prompt tokens extend this framework by specifying the target property, desired direction, and approximate magnitude of change. Multiple prompt tokens can be concatenated to enable multi-property optimization at inference time. For properties where pair supervision alone is insufficient, reinforcement learning post-training can further improve optimization, providing a tunable trade-off between proximity to the seed and the optimization objective. PairIT naturally supports pretraining on a large dataset and fine-tuning on a smaller dataset, which is critical for performance in data-sparse regimes. Surprisingly, we observe diminishing returns to the scale of the pretraining dataset. We demonstrate empirically on MoleculeNet and Therapeutics Data Commons datasets that, with appropriate paired-data curation, a standard transformer model of modest size (68M parameters) can achieve robust seeded molecular optimization in low-data regimes.

papers.title_en: MolHop: Scaffold-Hopping Molecular Design with Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Yanyi Su, Chenyan Wang, Yulei Gong, Yeyun Chen, Xiaohui Yang, Jun Cheng
papers.evidence: 面向跨骨架从头分子设计的智能体强化学习框架
papers.tldr: 分子设计常被视作在已有分子空间中的优化问题，但跨骨架发现结构迥异的新分子本质上是另一类搜索任务。MolHop 将约160万商业分子骨架组织为粗到细的层级动作空间，智能体通过骨架导航选择新探索区域、通过分子编辑调整性质，并以轨迹记忆支持长程搜索。接入 Grok-4.6 与 DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1 后跨骨架联合成功率显著提升；经智能体强化学习训练的 MolHop-9B 超越 GPT-5.6-sol、Claude-5-Opus、Gemini-3.1-Pro 等生成式基线，且候选分子与参考分子的骨架差异更大。
papers.abstract_en: Molecular design is often formulated as an optimization problem over existing molecular spaces. However, molecular optimization and the discovery of structurally distinct replacement molecules represent two fundamentally different search problems. LLM-based molecular design agents typically perform the former, conducting local refinement within the neighborhood of existing structures to improve target properties through structural modifications. In contrast, the latter requires exploration of a broader chemical space to discover molecules with entirely different scaffolds while preserving the functional characteristics of reference molecules. We propose MolHop, an agentic framework for cross-scaffold molecular discovery that enables models to navigate and edit within a pre-organized chemical space. MolHop organizes approximately 1.6 million molecular scaffolds from commercial molecules into a coarse-to-fine hierarchical action space. The agent selects new exploration regions through scaffold navigation actions and adjusts candidate properties through molecular editing. The framework maintains historical trajectory memory to support long-horizon search processes. On drug molecule and commercial compound tasks, connecting Grok-4.6 and DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1 to the MolHop framework substantially improves their cross-scaffold joint success rates. We develop MolHop-9B through agentic reinforcement learning, and MolHop-9B outperforms generative baselines including GPT-5.6-sol, Claude-5-Opus, and Gemini-3.1-Pro, while generating candidate molecules with larger scaffold differences from the reference molecules. These results demonstrate that effective molecular discovery beyond the traditional optimization paradigm requires structured chemical and action spaces, enabling agents to explore new structural regions rather than merely refine existing molecules.

papers.title_en: Blending experimental electron density information to protein-ligand interaction
papers.authors: Seonghyun Park, Shuan Chen, Jun Jin Choong, Noboru Kuno, Gyubok Lee, Kaushalya Madhawa, Keisuke Ozawa, Hikaru Shindo, Sungsoo Ahn
papers.evidence: 融合实验电子密度的蛋白质-配体相互作用模型
papers.tldr: 蛋白-配体相互作用预测多依赖拟合的原子坐标，会丢失结合界面的构象异质性、位置不确定性与局部电子密度支持。为此提出CoDE，将原子占据、实验电子密度及其梯度幅值融合到共享三维体素网格，用约10万复合物预训练通道式视觉Transformer，联合重建掩码的原子与密度通道。冻结编码器在泄漏控制的亲和力回归和口袋条件配体生成中，优于仅坐标预训练编码器，并与任务专用基线相当。表明密度信息可补充拟合坐标，且密度混合表征有助于基于结构的配体生成。
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models for protein-ligand interactions commonly rely on atomic coordinates, which are constructed by fitting molecular models to experimental electron-density maps. However, most models represent each complex as a single fitted structure, which can omit information about conformational heterogeneity, positional uncertainty, and local density support for individual atoms at binding interfaces. To fill this gap, we present CoDE, a Coordinate and Density Encoder, pre-trained on experimental density maps. We represent each binding site on a shared three-dimensional voxel grid combining atomic occupancy, experimental electron density, and its gradient magnitude. Using approximately 100K curated complexes, we pre-train a channel-wise vision transformer to jointly reconstruct masked atomic and density channels, learning a representation that integrates structural and experimental information. We evaluate the frozen encoder on two downstream tasks: (i) binding-affinity regression under leakage-controlled splits and (ii) pocket-conditioned ligand generation. Across these settings, CoDE improves over an identically pre-trained coordinate-only encoder and remains competitive with task-specific baselines, showing that density complements fitted atomic coordinates for protein-ligand interaction modeling and that the density-blended representation is useful for structure-based ligand generation.

papers.title_en: Multi-Objective Amortized CDRH3 Sequence Sampling Diversifies Promising Antibody Candidates
papers.authors: Joseph D. Viviano, Almer van der Sloot, Quentin Fournier, Robert M. Vernon, Christopher James Langmead, Yoshua Bengio
papers.evidence: 生成流网络用于基于结构的抗体设计与亲和力优化
papers.tldr: 抗体发现需兼顾亲和力与可开发性，现有方法常忽视多目标约束和候选多样性。作者提出偏好条件多目标GFN微调流程，用于固定框架CDRH3环重设计，整合最多14项低成本预测奖励，并引入AMPLIFY-350M跨度填充变体作先验与评分器。在45个留出复合物上，其比ProteinMPNN和ESM-IF在50%序列一致性下多产出约10倍可接受候选，并保留汇总14目标Pareto前沿的10%。该方法以单样本质量换更大探索空间，为多样化抗体设计提供新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Antibody therapeutics have transformed treatment across diverse therapeutic areas and have become central to modern medicine. While recent machine learning approaches aim to accelerate antibody discovery through structure-based design and target-affinity optimization, successful candidates must also satisfy broad developability constraints, including structural compatibility, low immunogenicity, and favorable biophysical properties, while remaining sufficiently diverse to provide sufficient coverage of design space to mitigate later-stage development failures. We introduce a preference-conditioned multi-objective generative flow network (GFN) fine-tuning pipeline for fixed-framework CDRH3 loop redesign that fine-tunes a biological sequence model against many inexpensive proxies covering backbone compatibility, sequence likelihood, immunogenicity risk, novelty, and developability liabilities. It combines up to fourteen predictive rewards in a single policy trained to sample CDRH3 loops across 623 SAbDab antibody structures, leveraging a reward reduction strategy to preserve Pareto dominance under this learned map. We also introduce a novel autoregressive span-in-filling variant of AMPLIFY-350M that serves both as a scaffold-conditioned CDRH3 generation prior and as a direct conditional likelihood scorer. We evaluated reward scores, diversity, and design quality on loops sampled on 45 held-out antibody complexes to assess structural consistency, confidence, aggregation propensity, stability, and antigen binding. Compared with the inverse-folding methods ProteinMPNN and ESM-IF, our approach produces roughly 10x more distinct acceptable candidates per design at 50% sequence identity, while holding 10% of the 14-objective Pareto front pooled across methods, trading per-sample quality for greater exploration of novel possible structures.

papers.authors: Ye Liu, Reza Averly, Avery Meyer, Frazier N. Baker, Ruoxi Gao, Daniel Adu-Ampratwum, Xia Ning
papers.evidence: 面向自主药物发现的多智能体LLM引擎
papers.tldr: 药物发现成本高、周期长，现有基于大语言模型的自主系统受限于单智能体难以处理长程多步任务，多智能体又常依赖预定义流程。MADDIE 以中心 Orchestrator 协调 HitIdentifier、LeadOptimizer、Synthesizer 和 Evaluator 四个专用智能体，动态组合灵活工作流，实现端到端药物发现。在 50 个蛋白靶点上，它能生成满足关键性质要求的分子及合成路线，大幅超越现有智能体系统、生成模型和通用 LLM，并兼顾时间与 token 效率。该工作为低成本、有效且高效的自主药物发现引擎提供了新方案，代码与数据集已公开。
papers.abstract_en: Drug discovery remains a resource-intensive and time-consuming process, involving billions of dollars and a decade of development to advance a drug to market. While many in silico tools have accelerated this process, operating them still demands substantial time, effort, and expertise from medicinal chemists. Autonomous systems built on Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising solution, yet current designs limit their performance. Existing single-agent systems scale poorly to long-horizon, multi-step, and realistic tasks, whereas multi-agent systems typically execute predefined workflows that cannot capture the iterative, non-linear nature of a real drug discovery campaign. Here, we present MADDIE, a multi-agent drug discovery engine. It comprises a central agent, Orchestrator, and four specialized worker agents: HitIdentifier, LeadOptimizer, Synthesizer, and Evaluator, each representing a critical step in a drug discovery campaign. Under Orchestrator's orchestration and coordination, these worker agents are composed into flexible workflows, enabling MADDIE to adapt its strategy and navigate the drug discovery pipeline end-to-end. Across 50 protein targets, MADDIE produces molecules satisfying key property requirements and their synthesis routes, outperforming existing agentic systems, generative models, and general-purpose LLMs by a wide margin. Our analysis reveals how these agents collaborate and that MADDIE can employ different strategies across targets to achieve the campaign's goal, while still being efficient in time and tokens. Together, they demonstrate MADDIE as a low-cost, effective, and efficient autonomous engine for accelerating drug discovery. Code and dataset is available via https://github.com/ninglab/MADDIE.

papers.title_en: zPocket: Better Pocket Finding with Frozen Co-Folding Features
papers.authors: Tally Portnoi, Allison M Keys, Benjamin R DiFrancesco, Nate Gruver
papers.evidence: 利用冻结共折叠特征进行口袋预测以支持基于结构的药物设计
papers.tldr: 蛋白质-配体结合位点识别对功能研究与药物开发关键，但现有方法未利用共折叠模型进行新口袋预测，且缺乏避免训练集泄漏的基准。为此，作者构建PocketWatch数据集，按序列、结构和隐蔽性分层评估泛化。并提出zPocket，在冻结的共折叠模型特征上训练口袋预测头。最佳模型总体per-target AUPRC达0.745，显著优于VN-EGNN、UniSite-1D和P2Rank等基线，还可通过聚类或重打分提升中心点召回，并用于片段筛选与人类蛋白质组未知口袋扫描。
papers.abstract_en: Identifying protein-ligand binding sites (pockets) is important for understanding protein function and developing drugs. However, no public method has leveraged co-folding models for novel pocket prediction; furthermore, this task lacks a suitable benchmark as existing benchmarks are within the training distribution of co-folding models. We therefore developed PocketWatch,a curated dataset of biologically relevant ligand pockets. The PocketWatch test set consists of unseen pockets stratified by sequence similarity, structural similarity, and crypticity to enable evaluation of generalization to novel and challenging pockets. Using this dataset, we develop zPocket, a method that trains pocket-prediction heads on top of frozen features from co-folding models. We show that zPocket heads outperform baseline methods across all stratifications. Our best zPocket model achieves overall per-target AUPRC of 0.745 compared to 0.598 and 0.595 for the strongest baselines, VN-EGNN and UniSite-1D retrained on the PocketWatch split (0.559 and 0.531 when using the published weights); the widely used P2Rank reaches 0.477. We further show that zPocket can be used to outperform baseline methods on top-N+2 recall of predicted pocket centroids through clustering per-residue predictions or using zPocket to rescore centroids proposed by other models. Finally, we explore two applications of zPocket: crystallographic fragment screens and a proteome-scale scan for uncharacterized pockets on human proteins. Together these results suggest that zPocket heads built on co-folding trunk features can greatly advance ligand binding site prediction.

papers.title_en: Accelerating dynamic polarizability calculations of organic molecules using equivariant graph neural networks
papers.authors: Houssam Metni, Maria Kraus, Marie Louise Schubert, Marjan Krstic, Carsten Rockstuhl, Pascal Friederich
papers.evidence: 等变图神经网络预测分子性质
papers.tldr: 有机分子动态极化率张量对光电器件模拟至关重要，但TD-DFT计算昂贵，限制大规模筛选。作者提出等变图神经网络，可从3D几何与UV-vis光谱直接预测频率相关复值极化率张量。模型在QM9和Harvard有机光伏数据集上重现主要色散与吸收特征，并能泛化到多样分子。下游器件光学仿真中，其电荷载流子生成率与TD-DFT高度一致（R²=0.94）。该工作为光活性有机分子快速筛选提供了有前景的替代或补充方案。
papers.abstract_en: Predicting the dynamic polarizability tensor of organic molecules is essential for simulating light-matter interactions in optoelectronic devices, yet conventional quantum-chemical methods such as time-dependent density functional theory (TD-DFT) are computationally expensive and limit large-scale screening. We present an equivariant graph neural network architecture that predicts frequency-dependent, complex-valued dynamic polarizability tensors directly from readily available molecular information, such as 3D geometry and UV-vis spectra. The model learns to approximate the shape and magnitude of the dynamic polarizability tensor, capturing both dispersive and absorptive features that define the molecular optical response. We evaluate the model on molecules from both the QM9 dataset and the Harvard organic photovoltaic dataset using various metrics, including the earth mover's distance, which is suitable for comparing spectral quantities. For both datasets, the model successfully reproduces the main features of the dynamic polarizability tensor and generalizes across diverse molecules. To assess the applicability, we further validated the model using a downstream workflow to calculate the optical properties of organic photovoltaic devices. We used the model-predicted polarizabilities to perform device-level optical simulations, yielding charge carrier generation rates in agreement with TD-DFT-based results ($R^2 = 0.94$). Our approach offers a promising complement, or even an alternative, to conventional methods such as TD-DFT, enabling faster and more efficient screening of photoactive organic molecules for optoelectronic applications.

papers.title_en: Zatom-2: Multitask Pretraining on Atomistic Data for Generative Modeling across Domains
papers.authors: Miruna Cretu, Alex Abrudan, Antonia Panescu, Tynan Perez, Rishabh Anand, N. Benjamin Erichson, Michael W. Mahoney, Samuel Blau, Joseph Jacobson, Rafael Gómez-Bombarelli, Rex Ying, Tuomas Knowles, Pietro Liò, Alex Morehead
papers.evidence: 基于条件流匹配的原子级生成模型用于分子生成
papers.tldr: 原子建模可桥接数据丰富的化学与数据稀缺的生物领域，但现有生成方法常局限于单一学科，或未兼用有机与无机数据。Zatom-2 基于500万 OMol25/OMat24 结构预训练，用多尺度 Transformer 与条件流匹配，支持生成、结构预测和能量/力预测。分子分布保真度优于 Zatom-1，分子/材料生成基准表现强劲，可控制低/高力区生成；联合生成-预测预训练与迁移学习，用2000个蛋白域微调，长度外推蛋白骨架可设计性从67.8%升至74.8%。
papers.abstract_en: Unified atomistic modeling has the potential to accelerate discovery in chemistry, materials science, and biology by bridging data-rich chemical domains and data-scarce biological contexts. However, existing generative approaches to atomistic modeling remain highly specialized to scientific disciplines (chemistry vs. biology) or do not leverage both high-volume organic (molecule) and inorganic (material) data for general-purpose pretraining. To this end, we introduce Zatom-2, an atomistic generative model pretrained on approximately five million structures from the OMol25 and OMat24 electronic structure datasets. Zatom-2 features a multiscale Transformer architecture coupled with conditional flow matching that supports force conditioning and foundational pretraining tasks such as generation, structure prediction, and prediction of molecular and material energies and forces. Empirically, Zatom-2 achieves better molecular distribution fidelity than Zatom-1 and achieves strong performance on existing molecule and material generation benchmarks. Zatom-2 demonstrates the ability to control sample generation across low- and high-force regimes, and enhances protein generation in a low-data setting through joint generative-predictive pretraining and transfer learning, increasing protein backbone designability in a length extrapolation setting from 67.8% without pretraining to 74.8% after finetuning on 2,000 protein domains.

papers.title_en: MPGE: A Multi-Perspective Graph Explainer for Molecular Classification Explanation
papers.evidence: 面向分子分类的图神经网络解释
papers.tldr: 图神经网络能预测分子性质，但预测准确并不解释图信息如何支撑单个决策。为此作者提出多视角图解释器MPGE，统一事实支持、反事实敏感性与样例容忍度三种视角，在冻结分类器上分别求解紧凑保留边集、有界改判删除与保持标签的删除。在MUTAG、Mutagenicity、AIDS、COX2_MD、BBP等数据集上，事实掩码平均仅保留8.6%–15.5%的输入边，反事实覆盖4.8%–67.6%，样例保持覆盖98.9%–100.0%。
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) predict molecular properties from chemical graph data, but predictive accuracy does not explain how graph information supports an individual decision. A compact prediction-preserving rationale does not necessarily reveal which changes reverse the decision or which modifications the model tolerates. We propose the Multi-Perspective Graph Explainer (MPGE), unifying factual support, counterfactual sensitivity, and exemplar tolerance for a frozen classifier. The factual view, originally termed prototype (PT), seeks a compact retained edge set with the same label and required confidence. Counterfactual (CF) explanations seek bounded prediction-changing deletions; exemplar (EXE) explanations seek non-trivial bounded deletions that preserve the label and confidence. A shared constrained formulation connects prediction behavior, compactness, and edit cost, while separate objectives generate the three views. Our graph-classification extension of CF-GNNExplainer learns symmetric edge rankings and verifies discrete candidates, recording unsuccessful searches. A separate BBBP fragment backend returns RDKit-sanitized molecules. We evaluate the primary GCN implementation on MUTAG, Mutagenicity, AIDS, COX2_MD, and BBBP using semantic coverage, conditional quality, stability, and runtime. Successful factual masks retained 8.6%--15.5% of input edges on average across datasets; bounded counterfactual coverage was 4.8%--67.6%, and exemplar preservation coverage was 98.9%--100.0%. Exploratory controls reveal the influence of hard projection and retained node information. Quantitative comparisons and molecular visualizations characterize model support, sensitivity, and tolerance without treating them as validated chemical mechanisms.

papers.title_en: MolP2SBench: Do LLMs Really Reason from Molecular Properties to Structure?
papers.authors: Yuhang Xie, Zhiyi Shi, Zeyi Zhang, Zhisheng Qi, Yushun Dong, Yu Wang, Xiongye Xiao
papers.evidence: 面向LLM分子性质到结构推理的基准
papers.tldr: 现有分子结构解析评测多聚焦端到端重构，正确结果未必代表模型真正利用给定物理性质。本文提出 MolP2SBench：输入掩码分子骨架与性质，要求LLM从候选结构中选出缺失结构，并通过打乱或替换性质检验其依赖性与反事实响应。评估七个模型发现，LLM确实能用性质预测结构，但不同性质表现悬殊，且准确率高不等于响应性强，甚至与化学直觉相悖。该基准为性质接地推理提供了统一诊断工具。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in molecular discovery and structure elucidation, where decisions depend on physical observations. Existing evaluations primarily focus on end-to-end molecular reconstruction, where correct predictions do not necessarily indicate reliance on the supplied properties. We introduce MolP2SBench, a benchmark for molecular property-to-structure (P2S) reasoning in LLMs. Each task presents a masked molecular scaffold with given properties and asks the model to select the missing structure from plausible candidates. We shuffle or replace properties to test reliance on correct property-structure pairing and responsiveness to counterfactual property changes. A channel-wise leaderboard uses Property-Grounded Recovery (PGR), giving equal weight to source and counterfactual recovery. Evaluating seven models, we find that LLMs can use physical properties for structure prediction, but performance varies substantially across property types. Higher accuracy with a property does not necessarily imply greater responsiveness to it: a model may benefit more from $^1$H NMR than from $^{13}$C NMR, yet be less likely to change its prediction when the $^1$H data is replaced. LLM performance also need not reflect the relative difficulty of these properties for human chemists. Although UV-Vis spectra provide less direct structural information than NMR spectra, Astra achieves higher accuracy with UV-Vis data than with NMR peaks. MolP2SBench supports studying how LLMs extract and use physical-property information, revealing patterns that may differ from conventional chemical intuition and providing a foundation for more reliably property-grounded models for molecular and quantum-chemical inference. Code and dataset: https://github.com/DUAL-Xiao/MolP2SBench.

papers.title_en: DrugTargetWorld: A Synthetic Biobank for Training and Benchmarking AI Scientists
papers.authors: Samuel Margolis, Paul Schmiedmayer, Alan Huang, Ethan Chen, Ishan Bhattacharjee, Atman Shah, Ben Viggiano, Fang Cao, Shriya Reddy, Roger Xia, Jack O'Sullivan, Daniel Katz, Matthew Wheeler, Euan Ashley, Bruna Gomes
papers.evidence: 用于训练与评测药物靶点发现AI的合成生物样本库
papers.tldr: 药物靶点发现需区分因果驱动分子与仅相关分子，但真实生物样本库缺乏已知因果真值且受访问限制。DrugTargetWorld程序化生成模拟生物样本库，每个世界含5.4万参与者的基因型、蛋白、健康记录与合成MRI，因果结构对评估者可见、对智能体隐藏。在20个心血管世界、540个回合中评测9个智能体，Opus 5与GPT-5.6 Sol综合分最高，平均找回64%因果驱动因子。该框架将端到端靶点发现转化为可扩展、带可验证奖励的训练与评测任务。
papers.abstract_en: Drug target discovery requires distinguishing molecules that causally drive disease from those that are merely associated with it. Training and evaluating AI agents to perform this workflow end-to-end is difficult because real world biobanks lack known causal ground truth and participant-level data is access controlled. We introduce DrugTargetWorld, a framework that procedurally generates simulated biobanks, or "worlds," with known but concealed causal structure. Each world contains genotypes, proteins, health records, outcomes, and synthetic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) for 54,000 participants. Agents must construct a disease phenotype, identify causal driver proteins, infer the beneficial direction of modulation, and optionally conduct virtual 'wet lab' experiments. We evaluated nine agents in 540 episodes across 20 cardiovascular worlds and three experimental budgets. Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol achieved the highest mean composite scores, 39.98 and 35.38 of 100, respectively, and both recovered 64% of causal drivers on average. However, no agent reliably distinguished misleading non-causal proteins, and performance remained limited by the integrative judgments required to connect phenotype construction, causal evidence, and intervention decisions. By making each world's causal structure known to the evaluator but hidden from the agent, DrugTargetWorld turns end-to-end drug target discovery into a scalable training and evaluation problem with verifiable reward.

papers.title_en: Designing Protein Structures from Natural Language
papers.authors: Joseph Lee, Yanjing Li, Bo Qiang, Gregory Lau, Allyson Ettinger, Noah A. Smith, Rory Donovan-Maiye, David Baker, Hanna Hajishirzi, Pang Wei Koh
papers.evidence: 文本条件全原子蛋白质结构生成
papers.tldr: 从头设计目标蛋白常需为不同属性定制输入，限制设计目标。作者提出 Prompteina，首个以自然语言为条件、支持全原子结构生成的模型，并构建含180万结构与5000万+文本的Prompteina-Data，通过文本条件预训练与微调对齐残基与文本。它在18项结构属性中15项超越基线，在结合体设计中至少13/20靶点领先，实验验证GM2A获9个结合体，最强表观K_D为107 nM。该工作将自然语言确立为蛋白质结构生成的有效通用控制接口。
papers.abstract_en: A central challenge in de novo protein design is generating proteins with desired structural and functional properties. Existing design models typically require a dedicated input representation for each property, limiting the design objectives they support. We develop Prompteina, the first all-atom structure generation model that supports new and broader design objectives specified in natural language, analogous to text-to-image generation. To train Prompteina, we construct Prompteina-Data, a paired text--protein structure dataset of 1.8M structures and 50M+ captions describing global and residue-specific structural and functional properties. We adapt Proteina-Complexa, a pretrained structure generation model, through text-conditioned pretraining and finetuning that aligns residues with their corresponding text. Prompteina outperforms baselines on 15 of 18 structural properties and generates proteins that more closely match descriptions of their intended functions. In binder design, it leads baselines on at least 13 of 20 targets and improves interface confidence by 14\% over the strongest baseline. With iterative in silico feedback, Prompteina's gain over non-iterative generation is 57\% larger than the next-best baseline on the hardest targets. Finally, we experimentally validate Prompteina designs against GM2A, a target with no reported de novo binders. We identify nine binders, with the strongest at an apparent $K_{\mathrm{D}}$ of 107 nM. These results establish natural language as an effective and powerful conditioning interface for protein structure generation.

papers.title_en: TagBO: LLM-Driven Task-Aware Graph Bayesian Optimization for Scientific Discovery
papers.authors: Xinzhe Yuan, Zimu Zeng, Zhuo Chen, Jianshu Zhang, Jinzong Dong, Jingyi Chen, Nanyang Ye, Huan Xiong, Qinying Gu
papers.evidence: 大模型驱动的贝叶斯优化用于分子与科学发现
papers.tldr: 科学发现中的混合变量优化常面临巨大组合空间与高昂实验代价，而现有贝叶斯优化依赖结构描述符定义类别变量相似度，隐含假设结构相似即任务性能相似，在真实科学任务中常不成立。TagBO 将 LLM 输出视为带噪的任务感知关系先验，从中提取粗粒度序关系信号，构建任务感知相似结构，并与描述符结构信息融合。随后在联合离散-连续表示空间上执行带约束的高斯过程贝叶斯优化。在化学与材料配方等多类任务上，TagBO 在固定评估预算下稳定提升样本效率，且对不同能力的 LLM 均有效。
papers.abstract_en: Mixed-variable optimization in scientific discovery often requires exploring large combinatorial spaces under costly experimental evaluations, making sample?efficient Bayesian optimization (BO) essential. However, existing BO methods typ?ically rely on structural descriptors to define similarity among categorical variables, implicitly assuming that structural similarity reflects similarity in task performance. In scientific optimization, this assumption is often violated, leading to surrogate representations that are poorly aligned with the optimization objective. To address this limitation, we propose TagBO (Task-aware Graph Bayesian Optimization), a method that integrates LLM-derived relational priors with descriptor-based struc?tural information for mixed-variable Bayesian optimization. Rather than directly using LLM outputs as predictive scores, TagBO treats LLM outputs as a potentially noisy source of task-aware relational priors and extracts coarse ordinal relational signals from LLM reasoning to construct task-aware similarity structures for scien?tific optimization. TagBO then performs constrained Gaussian process Bayesian optimization over the resulting joint discrete-continuous representation space. Ex?periments on diverse chemistry and materials formulation tasks demonstrate that TagBO consistently improves sample efficiency under fixed evaluation budgets across LLMs of varying capabilities.
